From f7cf8ece8cee3c1ee361991470cdb1eb65ab02e8 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Zhengchuan Liang <zcliangcn@gmail.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 23:10:26 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] net: caif: clear client service pointer on teardown

`caif_connect()` can tear down an existing client after remote shutdown by
calling `caif_disconnect_client()` followed by `caif_free_client()`.
`caif_free_client()` releases the service layer referenced by
`adap_layer->dn`, but leaves that pointer stale.

When the socket is later destroyed, `caif_sock_destructor()` calls
`caif_free_client()` again and dereferences the freed service pointer.

Clear the client/service links before releasing the service object so
repeated teardown becomes harmless.

Fixes: 43e369210108 ("caif: Move refcount from service layer to sock and dev.")
Cc: stable@kernel.org
Reported-by: Yifan Wu <yifanwucs@gmail.com>
Reported-by: Juefei Pu <tomapufckgml@gmail.com>
Co-developed-by: Yuan Tan <yuantan098@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Yuan Tan <yuantan098@gmail.com>
Suggested-by: Xin Liu <bird@lzu.edu.cn>
Tested-by: Ren Wei <enjou1224z@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Zhengchuan Liang <zcliangcn@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Ren Wei <n05ec@lzu.edu.cn>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/9f3d37847c0037568aae698ca23cd47c6691acb0.1775897577.git.zcliangcn@gmail.com
Signed-off-by: Paolo Abeni <pabeni@redhat.com>

diff --git a/net/caif/cfsrvl.c b/net/caif/cfsrvl.c
index 171fa32ada85..d687fd0b4ed3 100644
--- a/net/caif/cfsrvl.c
+++ b/net/caif/cfsrvl.c
@@ -191,10 +191,20 @@ bool cfsrvl_phyid_match(struct cflayer *layer, int phyid)
 
 void caif_free_client(struct cflayer *adap_layer)
 {
+	struct cflayer *serv_layer;
 	struct cfsrvl *servl;
-	if (adap_layer == NULL || adap_layer->dn == NULL)
+
+	if (!adap_layer)
+		return;
+
+	serv_layer = adap_layer->dn;
+	if (!serv_layer)
 		return;
-	servl = container_obj(adap_layer->dn);
+
+	layer_set_dn(adap_layer, NULL);
+	layer_set_up(serv_layer, NULL);
+
+	servl = container_obj(serv_layer);
 	servl->release(&servl->layer);
 }
 EXPORT_SYMBOL(caif_free_client);
-- 
2.34.1

This patch fixes a use-after-free bug in the CAIF networking stack by modifying the `caif_free_client()` function in `net/caif/cfsrvl.c`.

The core issue is that when a socket is torn down after a remote shutdown, `caif_free_client()` releases the service layer (`servl`) but leaves the adaptation layer's pointer `adap_layer->dn` stale. A subsequent call to `caif_free_client()` (from `caif_sock_destructor()`) dereferences that freed pointer, causing a crash.

The fix makes the following changes to `caif_free_client()`:

1. **Add null checks** for `adap_layer` and its `dn` pointer to bail out early if already cleared.
2. **Save the service layer pointer** (`serv_layer = adap_layer->dn`) before nullifying the link.
3. **Clear the bidirectional client/service links**:  
   `layer_set_dn(adap_layer, NULL)` and `layer_set_up(serv_layer, NULL)`. This ensures that subsequent calls see a NULL `dn` and return safely.
4. **Proceed with the release** (`servl->release(&servl->layer)`) only after the pointers are cleared.

These modifications are contained within a single file (`net/caif/cfsrvl.c`) and collectively prevent double-free use-after-free errors on repeated teardown, while maintaining the same release logic for the initial call. The relationship between the changes is that each pointer clearing is paired with the corresponding null check, and the ordering (clear pointers *before* release) is critical to avoid accessing freed memory.

net: caif: clear client service pointer on teardown

`caif_connect()` can tear down an existing client after remote shutdown by

repeated teardown becomes harmless.

Reported-by: Yifan Wu <yifanwucs@gmail.com>
Reported-by: Juefei Pu <tomapufckgml@gmail.com>

Signed-off-by: Paolo Abeni <pabeni@redhat.com>

Here is the root cause:
After caif_free_client() releases the service layer object, the pointer `adap_layer->dn` is not cleared, leaving a dangling reference. A subsequent call to `caif_free_client()` (e.g., from `caif_sock_destructor()`) dereferences the freed pointer, causing a use-after-free crash.

Here is the patch:
 
 void caif_free_client(struct cflayer *adap_layer)
 {
+	struct cflayer *serv_layer;
 	struct cfsrvl *servl;
-	if (adap_layer == NULL || adap_layer->dn == NULL)
+
+	if (!adap_layer)
+		return;
+
+	serv_layer = adap_layer->dn;
+	if (!serv_layer)
 		return;
-	servl = container_obj(adap_layer->dn);
+
+	layer_set_dn(adap_layer, NULL);
+	layer_set_up(serv_layer, NULL);
+
+	servl = container_obj(serv_layer);
 	servl->release(&servl->layer);
 }
 EXPORT_SYMBOL(caif_free_client);
